title: Open-Source Ledger Nano X Flutter SDK & VESPR Wallet Integration

ms.promise:
Research and Analysis:
・We will undertake a comprehensive analysis of the technical requirements and potential strategies for developing a Flutter SDK that can integrate Ledger Nano X with Cardano wallets and/or dApps

Proof of Concept:
・New flutter project and repository setup
・Based on one/more of the strategies mentioned in the research and analysis document
・Successfully detect Ledger Nano X devices via bluetooth on physical phone
・Successfully connect to Ledger Nano X device
・Successfully fetch the Cardano receive address of the ledger device
ms.criteria:
Research and Analysis:
・Create a report outlining the different technical strategies (and their challenges) for developing a flutter SDK for Ledger Nano X integration

Proof of Concept 
・Open-source Github link to new repository for the Cardano Ledger Flutter SDK
・Use above research when attempting to create the proof of concept
・Successfully detect and connect to a Ledger Nano X via Flutter on a mobile device
・Successfully receive the first cardano address of the ledger wallet
ms.report:
Research and Analysis:
Document containing research and analysis outlining multiple potential approaches to developing the ledger flutter SDK for Cardano
・https://drive.google.com/file/d/1i1WKqd9mQjW_BDgkgAe2PRFMYx-ymdCs/view?usp=drive_link

Proof of Concept:
URLs to open-sourced repositories
・https://github.com/vespr-wallet/ledger-cardano 
・Flutter SDK for Cardano-specific ledger operations
・Works as a plugin for ledger-flutter SDK (see below)

・https://github.com/vespr-wallet/ledger-flutter
・Flutter SDK for general ledger device connectivity
・Modified fork/copy of https://github.com/RootSoft/ledger-flutter to make some minor bug fixes

Photo/video evidence showing the mobile device connecting to Ledger and fetching cardano receive address
・Video showing Ledger Nano X device connecting to mobile device and (1) showing prompt to pair ledger to phone, (2) displaying receive address on ledger, (3) returning from ledger and showing the same receive address on the phone: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1KkTjX6WXnW5jWBUp0OL0M8Wscl5qRkv4/view?usp=drive_link

ms.promise: Expand on the proof of concept to design and develop a full-fledged prototype Cardano Flutter SDK for Ledger Nano X. The prototype will be able to perform all operations required for dApp/wallet integrations.
ms.criteria:
SDK can be used to connect to Ledger device and:
・read the serial number of the ledger device
・read Ledger's Cardano app version
・fetch extended public key for the wallet
・fetch receive/change/staking addresses for the wallet
・approve/sign transactions (and returns witnesses)
